questions.question: Differentiate between mixtures and compounds across 5 distinct criteria.
questions.correct_answer: 1. Formation: Mixtures formed by physical mixing; Compounds by chemical bonding. 2. Composition: Mixtures have variable ratios; Compounds fixed ratios. 3. Properties: Mixtures retain constituent traits; Compounds display new traits. 4. Separation: Mixtures separated by physical methods; Compounds require chemical/electrical methods. 5. Energy: Mixtures show no heat change during mixing; Compounds involve energy absorption/release.
